feed.title: JHELA — International Scholarly Calls and Announcements
feed.subtitle: Verified founding-stage announcements from the Journal of Human-Centred Education, Learning and Assessment. Formal manuscript submissions are not open.

entry.title: International Call for Reviewers — Expressions of Interest
entry.summary: JHELA invites qualified researchers in education, learning, assessment, language education and associated disciplines to express interest in independent scholarly reviewing. Applications are considered individually; no appointment is automatic.

entry.title: Founding Editorial Collaboration — International Expressions of Interest
entry.summary: Researchers with relevant academic and methodological experience may propose participation in JHELA's developing editorial community. Roles require verified qualifications, informed acceptance and conflict-of-interest safeguards.
